narrative.overview: A bright, airy travel journal (light by default, deep slate by toggle): real photographs of Tingo María as the main event, and a single warm thread of aged gold marking the details that matter.
keyCharacteristics: Light, airy canvas by default with a true dark slate inversion behind the header toggle
One inline-SVG line icon set (1.75 stroke, round)
Próximamente photo showcase directly after the hero
Gold glow only on the Reservar border
Usable without JavaScript and under reduced motion

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Teal fills mark actions only; accents, labels and icons are gold.

rules.name: The Contrast Pair Rule
rules.body: Small text uses --enlace and --oro-texto, never the raw brand teal or gold.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Voice Rule
rules.body: Playfair is for headings only; UI, forms and buttons are always Lato.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces by tone and hairlines; light cards may carry the single soft --sombra, dark ones none.

dos: Do let real photos carry the page; keep the interface quiet around them.
Do use teal fills for actions and gold for labels, icons and accents.
Do keep the hero, covers, footer, top bar and lightbox dark in both themes.
Do keep every effect usable without JS and off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do credit every third-party photo in creditos.html.
donts: Don't use raw gold or teal for small text; use --oro-texto and --enlace.
Don't add drop shadows for depth: tone steps and hairlines, plus the one soft --sombra on light cards.
Don't put credit text on or beside photos, or crop/mask a watermark.
Don't present a photo as a different place than it shows.
Don't import brand content from the Terra spec (names, destinations, testimonials).
